issue.author: aeubanks
issue.body:
`$ cat /tmp/a.ll`

```llvm
  target datalayout = "e-m:x-p:32:32-p270:32:32-p271:32:32-p272:64:64-i64:64-i128:128-f80:128-n8:16:32-a:0:32-S32"
  target triple = "i386-pc-windows-msvc19.34.0"
  
  @global = external constant [2 x i8]
  
  define x86_thiscallcc i1 @wibble() {
  bbl:
    %icmp = icmp eq i32 add (i32 sub (i32 0, i32 ptrtoint (ptr getelementptr inbounds nuw (i8, ptr @global, i32 2) to i32)), i32 ptrtoint (ptr @global to i32)), 0
    ret i1 %icmp
  }
```  
```console
$ llc /tmp/a.ll -o /dev/null
llc: ../../llvm/include/llvm/ADT/APInt.h:128: llvm::APInt::APInt(unsigned int, uint64_t, bool, bool): Assertion `llvm::isUIntN(BitWidth, val) && "Value is not an N-bit unsigned value"' failed.
```
issue.title: [DAGCombiner] Assertion `llvm::isUIntN(BitWidth, val) && "Value is not an N- bit unsigned value"' failed.
